guitar.evidence: Jim Root has well-documented, long-running Fender signature models (Jim Root Telecaster and Stratocaster); Mick Thomson has a Jackson signature model. Both are well known in metal guitar gear circles.

tone.target: tight modern nu-metal rhythm with scooped mids and percussive palm-mutes
tone.profile: tight modern nu-metal rhythm with scooped mids and percussive palm-mutes
tone.summary: High gain, tight Rectifier-style distortion into a 4x12 cabinet, optimized for percussive palm-muting and scooped mids.

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise from high-gain rhythm playing.
